title: MD Desk data contract, version 2 (Machinedrum OS 1.63)
description: Plain-data documents exchanged between MD Desk's UI and its data layer. Produced and checked by elektronData (patternToJson/patternFromJson etc.) and mdDataLink::Session::stateToJson. Values are firmware units; see data-contract.md for display units and the mockup mapping. Cross-field limits (length <= totalLength, lock budget, song structure) are checked by elektronData::validate and listed in data-contract.md. Readers must ignore unknown members.

steps64.description: Sorted 0-based step numbers. Below 64 (extended dumps) or 32 (classic dumps).

nameTail.description: Bytes after the name's NUL, only present when not all zero (factory data keeps leftovers).

editAll.description: 1 = one pattern-wide set (ALL), 0 = per-track sets in tracks[].

name.description: Derived from slot; ignored on input.

kit.description: Linked kit, recalled in EXTENDED mode.

locks.description: The pooled parameter locks: at most 64 distinct (track, param), in firmware order.

steps.description: [step, value] for each locked step below totalLength.

firmware.description: P6, contract version 2: what the firmware carries that the editor passes through untouched (dump format bytes, residue, opaque state, undecoded bytes). Readers also take version 1, where these members sit at the top level.

lockedRowsField.description: Opaque firmware byte, 0 in every observed dump.

lockPoolHidden.description: Run-length [count, byte] residue of the lock pool outside the semantic view (unused rows, steps past totalLength). Present only when not canonical; dropped when the lock layout changes.

model.description: OS 1.63 machine id; UW machines have bit 7 set.

machine.description: Manual name (TRX-BD, P-I-SD, ROM-05); derived, ignored on input.

effects.description: AMD AMF EQF EQG FLTF FLTW FLTQ SRR

routing.description: DIST VOL PAN DEL REV LFOS LFOD LFOM

gateBox.description: DVOL PRED DEC DAMP HP LP GATE LEV

rhythmEcho.description: TIME MOD MFRQ FB FILTF FILTW MONO LEV

eq.description: LF LG HF HG PF PG PQ GAIN

dynamix.description: ATCK REL TRHD RTIO KNEE HP OUTG MIX

firmware.description: P6, contract version 2: what the firmware carries that the editor passes through untouched (dump format bytes, residue, opaque state, undecoded bytes). Readers also take version 1, where these members sit at the top level.

items.description: Opaque firmware LFO state, kept as-is.

lfoState.description: Per track: the LFO block's opaque running state (was tracks[].lfo.state in version 1).

repeats.description: pattern: extra passes (REP = repeats + 1); loop: extra passes of the body, 0 = infinite

end.description: Step after the last one played.

tempo.description: BPM, null = keep the previous tempo

target.description: loop: an earlier row; jump: a later row

raw.description: The row's fields as stored (pattern, reserved, repeats, target, mutes, tempo x 24, start, end), only when the kind's fields would not rebuild it.

rows.description: At most 256 rows including the final END.

firmware.description: P6, contract version 2: what the firmware carries that the editor passes through untouched (dump format bytes, residue, opaque state, undecoded bytes). Readers also take version 1, where these members sit at the top level.

routing.description: Per-track output; A-F skip the master effects.

keymap.description: MIDI note -> 0-15 track trig; 16-31 appear in the Elektron default map (notes 64-89), meaning not verified.

control.description: P5: the measured meaning of settings (elektronData::mdGlobalBits), derived and read-only: settings is the value. Change it with {op: globalSet, field, on|v}.

localControl.description: Stored; no effect was seen in the emulator (not verified).

firmware.description: P6, contract version 2: what the firmware carries that the editor passes through untouched (dump format bytes, residue, opaque state, undecoded bytes). Readers also take version 1, where these members sit at the top level.

modulators.description: App-only LFO and random sources and their links to kit parameters (page -> desk).

setup.description: The editor's setup kept with the project (P4, mdDesk/mdDeskSetup.h): the app modulators and the CCs of the eight controller knob rows. Stored by the plug-in as the MDSK chunk of its state.

lifecycle.description: P6: the machine's life as one value (deskCore::Lifecycle): the engine label and the input gate follow it.

capabilities.description: P6: what the engine can do, as data (deskCore::Capabilities). A page enables a control when its capability is true and shows reasons[name] otherwise.

engine.description: The engine map's id of the engine the desk runs on.

label.description: The LCD's engine label while ready.

about.description: The engine label's tooltip while ready.

reasons.description: Why a capability is false (its name -> the text a disabled control shows).

engines.description: P6: the engine map (the plug-in's engine records), in menu order; empty for a desk outside the plug-in.

history.description: P6: the core's undo history (a gesture is one step).

queued.description: Selected while playing; becomes current at the end of the current pattern.

working.description: edited = not saved on the machine: lost on LOAD KIT or a switch to a pattern linked to another kit.

reloadNeeded.description: The current song's slot was rewritten; heard after STOP, LOAD SONG, PLAY.

patternKits.description: [pattern slot, kit] for every pattern seen in a dump.

desk.description: Added by the desk for the page: the adapter's state (P6: every member declared).

firmware.description: The engine: NO ROM, ROM ERROR, LOADING ROM, BOOTING OS, EMU OS 1.63. P4: ready only when the start-up animation is over (keys work). Deprecated (P6): the pages read machine.lifecycle; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

engine.description: P4: the emulated MD OS 1.63, or HW MIDI: a real Machinedrum on the plug-in's MIDI in/out. Deprecated (P6): the pages read machine.capabilities.engine; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

link.description: P4, HW MIDI: connect (HW CONNECT, no reply yet), ready (HW MIDI), lost (HW NO MIDI: no reply for 3.5 s, or none in 5 s after choosing it). local for the emulator. Deprecated (P6): the pages read machine.lifecycle; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

boot.description: P4: off (no firmware running), starting (no status reply yet), animation (the firmware answers MIDI but its start-up animation ignores panel keys), ready. Deprecated (P6): the pages read machine.lifecycle; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

tx.description: An edit is on the wire (waiting for its read-back).

roundTripMs.description: Last edit -> read-back time; -1 before the first.

undo.description: Deprecated (P6): the pages read machine.history; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

redo.description: Deprecated (P6): the pages read machine.history; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

undoCount.description: Deprecated (P6): the pages read machine.history; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

redoCount.description: Deprecated (P6): the pages read machine.history; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

queued.description: Selected while playing and not heard yet (clears at the playhead wrap).

recording.description: Live recording (RECORD held + PLAY): the RECORD LED blinks while playing.

gridEdit.description: Grid edit (RECORD alone): the RECORD LED is steady.

knobPage.description: DATA ENTRY page: 0 synthesis, 1 effects, 2 routing, -1 unknown.

telemetry.description: Playhead and state come from MD OS 1.63 RAM.

mutes.description: The machine's pattern mutes (P4: read from RAM 0x28b34a when mutesSource is memory).

mutesSource.description: memory: read from the machine (its MUTE window and CCs show too). tracked: what the desk sent and saw.

oneOf.description: The firmware's pattern chain (P4, BANK held + TRIG keys). One bank, each pattern once, loops.

active.description: False after a LOAD PATTERN or a single TRIG with BANK held.

next.description: The entry the firmware queues next.

chain.description: null: not readable on this firmware.

recLock.description: P4, live recording: the trig the last knob turn locks (mdDesk::nextLockStep), for about 3 s.

bankGroup.description: The machine's BANK GROUP: 0 A-D, 1 E-H, -1 unknown.

kitSource.description: memory: the current kit document is the working kit read from the machine's memory (P3). tracked: the stored slot plus the edits the desk saw. Deprecated (P6): the pages read the working kit document's source; kept for older readers, removed in the next contract version.

audioDevices.description: The standalone's audio and MIDI devices (P6, mdJucePlugin/mdAudioMidiLink.cpp; data-contract.md 4.8). Not machine data. In a plug-in only schema, version and standalone:false.

message.description: P6: every message the plug-in sends the Machinedrum Editor page (Bridge gm.recv). Checked by mdDeskTest against what the desk publishes.

oneOf.description: The machine table, once after ready.

pending.description: The document shows an edit submitted to the machine and not yet read back (P6: pending, published merged over observed).

slot.description: The slot; for the working kit, the kit it was loaded from.

source.description: P6: where the observed document came from.

oneOf.description: A document: a stored slot (pattern, kit, song, global) or the kit that plays (workingKit, P6).
A command that would lose something asks first; the page sends it again with force.
The firmware's own LCD while it starts: 128 x 64, one bit a pixel, row-major, base64.
The engine changed: the page starts its documents over.
The standalone's audio and MIDI devices (host, mdAudioMidiLink).

command.description: Generated from the model's command table and the plug-in's (deskHost), P6: every command the page may send.

oneOf.description: core: the page is up: everything is published once more
core: undo the last step (a drag is one step)
core: a whole document as the intent
core: a trig on or off (toggles without on)
core: a parameter lock; v null clears it
core: a mute or trig group
core: the kit that plays, live (0x55)
core: a GLOBAL setting by name
machine: LOAD PATTERN (queued while playing; now: STOP, LOAD, PLAY)
machine: SAVE KIT to the current slot
machine: LOAD KIT of the current slot
machine: REC as on the machine
machine: a TRIG key while recording
setup: the eight knob rows' CCs
host: an entry of the engine map (machine.engines)
host: look for the ROM again
host: a channel message from the page: [status 0x80-0xef, data, data]
host: MIDI learn a track's parameter
host: a CC mapping without learning
host: a controller row's CC changed: its mappings follow
host: the standalone's audio and MIDI devices
